title: Number of Steps to Reduce a Number in Binary Representation to One
description: Given a binary string, return the number of steps to reduce it to 1. If odd, add 1; if even, divide by 2.

steps.note: Initialize steps to 0 and carry to 0. Input: '1101'
Start iteration from last bit: s[3] = 1. bit = 1 + 0 = 1
Bit is 1 (odd), add 1 to carry, steps becomes 2
Bit is 1 (odd), add 1 to carry, steps becomes 2 + 2 = 4
Bit is 2 (even), steps becomes 4 + 1 = 5, carry remains 1
